renderings.value: Light escaped from the apartment complex surrounding the park.
The apartment buildings stood side by side in the darkness of the night.
Even the apartment buildings were the same as they used to be.
Before me, in my line of sight, stood several apartment buildings side by side.
I had decided to spend the hot summer without leaving the apartment building.
Our destination was the supermarket within the apartment complex.
There's a single supermarket in the apartment complex which adjoins the bus stop, a few minutes' walk away.
